## Methods


```{r}
#| include: false

# Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(AOData)
library(lme4)
library(gt)
library(marginaleffects)
library(cowplot)
library(ggtext)


# Settings for figures

colors <- c("#e66101", "#fdb863","#b2abd2","#5e3c99")
basesize <- 18


```


```{r}
#| label: tbl-participants
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| tbl-cap: "Characteristics of participants completing T4. Data are presented as Mean (SD)."



## Participants
# Only from completed to T4
part <- AOData::idkeys %>%
  filter(completed == "t4")


part %>%
  select(participant:bmi) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(age, bmi)) %>%
  
  
  summarise(.by = c(treat, sex, name),
            m = mean(value), 
            s = sd(value), 
            n = n()) %>%
  
  pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = c(m,s,n)) %>%
  select(-n_age) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = m_age:n_bmi,
              names_from = treat) %>%
  mutate(sex = if_else(sex == "m", "Male", "Female")) %>%
  

  
  
  gt() %>%
  
  fmt_number(columns = starts_with("m"), decimals = 1) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = starts_with("s"), decimals = 1) %>%
  
  cols_merge(columns = c("m_age_omega", "s_age_omega"), 
             pattern = "<<{1}>> <<({2})>>") %>%
    cols_merge(columns = c("m_bmi_omega", "s_bmi_omega"), 
             pattern = "<<{1}>> <<({2})>>") %>%
  
    cols_merge(columns = c("m_age_ctrl", "s_age_ctrl"), 
             pattern = "<<{1}>> <<({2})>>") %>%
    cols_merge(columns = c("m_bmi_ctrl", "s_bmi_ctrl"), 
             pattern = "<<{1}>> <<({2})>>") %>%
  
  
  cols_move(m_bmi_ctrl, m_age_ctrl) %>%
  cols_move(n_bmi_ctrl, m_bmi_ctrl) %>%
  
  cols_label(sex = "Sex") %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Placebo", 
              columns = c(m_age_ctrl,m_bmi_ctrl,n_bmi_ctrl)) %>%
    tab_spanner(label = "Omega-3", 
              columns = c(m_age_omega,m_bmi_omega,n_bmi_omega)) %>%
  cols_label(m_age_ctrl = "Age", 
             m_bmi_ctrl = "BMI", 
             n_bmi_ctrl = "n", 
             m_age_omega = "Age", 
             m_bmi_omega = "BMI", 
             n_bmi_omega = "n" )
  
  
            



```


```{r}
#| label: "fig-fig1"
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-cap: "Participants included in the study. Bars in the histogram are stacked."



part <- AOData::idkeys 


## Descriptives data 

dat <- AOData::bodycomp %>%
  select(participant, time, lean.whole, BMC.whole, fat.whole)  %>%
  mutate(weight = lean.whole + BMC.whole + fat.whole) %>%
  inner_join(part %>% mutate(participant = as.character(participant))) %>%
  filter(time == "T1") %>%
  ## Calculate height based on weight (DXA) and BMI 
  mutate(height = 100 * sqrt((weight/1000) / bmi)) %>%
  ## Calculate relative lean and fat
  mutate(lean.rel = 100 * (lean.whole / weight), 
         fat.rel = 100 * (fat.whole/weight), 
         # Weight in kg
         weight = weight / 1000) %>%
  select(participant, 
         treat, 
         completed, 
         sex, 
         age, 
         height, 
         weight, 
         lean.rel, 
         fat.rel, 
         bmi) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = age:bmi)

## Summarise descriptives
dat_sum <- dat %>%
  summarise(.by = c(sex, name), 
            m = mean(value), 
            s = sd(value), 
            n = n()) %>%
  mutate(stat = paste0(sprintf("%.1f", round(m, 1)), 
                       " (", 
                       sprintf("%.1f", round(s, 1)), 
                       ")")) %>%
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c("age", 
                                        "height", 
                                        "weight", 
                                        "bmi", 
                                        "lean.rel", 
                                        "fat.rel"), 
                       labels = c("Age (yrs)", 
                                  "Stature (cm)", 
                                  "Body mass (kg)", 
                                  "Body mass index", 
                                  "Lean mass (%)", 
                                  "Fat mass (%)")), 
         sex = factor(sex, levels = c("f", "m"), 
                      labels = c("Female", "Male"))) %>%
  mutate(.by = name, 
         pos = mean(m) + 1 * mean(s)) %>%
    mutate(.by = sex, 
         sex_n = paste(sex, "n = ",mean(n)))




p <- dat %>%
   mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c("age", 
                                        "height", 
                                        "weight", 
                                        "bmi", 
                                        "lean.rel", 
                                        "fat.rel"), 
                       labels = c("Age (yrs)", 
                                  "Stature (cm)", 
                                  "Body mass (kg)", 
                                  "Body mass index", 
                                  "Lean mass (%)", 
                                  "Fat mass (%)")), 
         sex = factor(sex, levels = c("f", "m"), 
                      labels = c("Female", "Male"))) %>%
  mutate(.by = c(sex,name), 
         sex_n = paste(sex, "n = ",n())) %>%
  
  
  ggplot(aes(value, color = sex_n, fill = sex_n)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, color = "gray10") + 
  
  geom_richtext(data = filter(dat_sum, sex == "Male"), 
            aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, color = sex_n, label = paste("&#9794;",stat)), 
                hjust = -1.6, vjust = 1, 
              show.legend = FALSE,
                 fill = NA, label.color = NA, # remove background and outline
    label.padding = grid::unit(rep(0, 4), "pt")) + # remove padding) +
   geom_richtext(data = filter(dat_sum, sex == "Female"), 
               aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, color = sex_n, label = paste("&#9792;",stat)),
               show.legend = FALSE,
                hjust = -1.6, vjust = 2.5, 
                 fill = NA, label.color = NA, # remove background and outline
    label.padding = grid::unit(rep(0, 4), "pt")) + # remove padding) 
  
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c(colors[1], colors[3])) + 
 scale_fill_manual(values = c(colors[1], colors[3])) +  
  
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 26)) +
  facet_wrap(~ name, scales = "free") + 
  labs(y = "Count") +
  
  
  theme_classic(base_size = basesize) + 
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(color = "white"), 
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0), 
        legend.title = element_blank(), 
        axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "bottom")
  
  p


ggsave("pn-2024-figures/fig1.pdf",
```

## Included excluded


```{r}
#| label: "fig-fig2"
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-cap: "Drop-out analysis of baseline characteristics. Estimates show differences in baseline characteristics between included and excluded participants in per-protocol analysis (included vs. excluded). Error bars in B show 95% CI. P-values from average differences between included and excluded, treatment interaction indicate interaction between treatment groups and drop-out. Participants included in per-protocol analysis tended to be older than drop-outs."


# Test if drop-outs differ from the rest
library(nlme)


names <- unique(dat$name) 
results <- list()
comp <- list()


for(i in seq_along(names)) {
  
  dat_temp <- dat %>%
    filter(name == names[i]) %>%
    mutate(included = if_else(completed == "t4", "incl", "excl"))
  
  m <- nlme::gls(value ~ included + sex, 
                 weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1|included*sex),
                 data = dat_temp)
  
  m2 <- nlme::gls(value ~ included*treat + sex, 
                 weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1|included*sex),
                 data = dat_temp)
  
 comp[[i]] <-  data.frame(predictions(m2, newdata = expand_grid(included = c( "incl", "excl"), 
                                                    treat = c("omega", "ctrl"), 
                                                    sex = c("m", "f")), 
                         by = c("included", "treat"))) %>%
    mutate(name = names[i])
  
  
  results[[i]] <- cbind(name = names[i],
                   comp = "included vs. excluded",
                   data.frame(est = coef(summary(m))[2,1], 
                   se = coef(summary(m))[2,2], 
                   tval = coef(summary(m))[2,3], 
                   pval = coef(summary(m))[2,4],
                   pval.treat.interact = coef(summary(m2))[5,4]),
        data.frame(lwr = intervals(m)$coef[2,][1], 
                   upr = intervals(m)$coef[2,][3])) %>%
    data.frame(row.names = NULL) 
  
  
}


p <- bind_rows(results) %>%
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c("age", 
                                        "height", 
                                        "weight", 
                                        "bmi", 
                                        "lean.rel", 
                                        "fat.rel"), 
                       labels = c("Age (yrs)", 
                                  "Stature (cm)", 
                                  "Body mass (kg)", 
                                  "Body mass index", 
                                  "Lean mass (%)", 
                                  "Fat mass (%)"))) %>%
  
  mutate(stat_incl = paste("p = ", 
                           sprintf("%.3f",round(pval, 3) )), 
         stat_interact = paste("p = ", 
                               sprintf("%.3f",round(pval.treat.interact, 3)))) %>%
  mutate(stat_incl = if_else(name == "Fat mass (%)", paste("Included vs. excluded: ", stat_incl), stat_incl), 
         stat_interact= if_else(name == "Fat mass (%)", paste("Treatment interaction: ", stat_interact), stat_interact)) %>%
  
           ggplot(aes(name, est)) + 
   geom_hline(yintercept = 0, lty = 2, color = "gray30") +
           geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), 
                         width = 0.1) +
  
  geom_text(aes(name, Inf, label = stat_incl), 
            vjust = -1, 
            hjust = 1, 
            color = colors[1]) +
    geom_text(aes(name, Inf, label = stat_interact), 
            vjust = 1, 
            hjust = 1, 
            color = colors[4]) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-8, 8)) +
  
            geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3,
                       fill = colors[2], size = 2) + 
  


      theme_classic(base_size = basesize) + 
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(color = "white"), 
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0), 
        legend.title = element_blank(), 
        axis.title = element_blank(), 
        legend.position = "bottom") + 
  coord_flip()
  

p 


ggsave("pn-2024-figures/fig2.pdf", 
       p,
       width = 20, 
       device = cairo_pdf,
       height = 12, units = "cm")
```


```{r}
#| label: "fig-fig3"
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 3
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-cap: "Comparisons of baseline characteristics among treatment groups in participants included/excluded for pre-protocol analysis.Error bars show minimum and maximum values together with first and thirt quartile, points are medians. P-values from comparisons of average differences between included/excluded and treatment with inclusion interactions."

stats <- bind_rows(results)  %>%
  select(name, pval, pval.treat.interact) %>%
   mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c("age", 
                                        "height", 
                                        "weight", 
                                        "bmi", 
                                        "lean.rel", 
                                        "fat.rel"), 
                       labels = c("Age<br>(yrs)", 
                                  "Stature<br>(cm)", 
                                  "Body mass<br>(kg)", 
                                  "Body mass<br>index", 
                                  "Lean mass<br>(%)", 
                                  "Fat mass<br>(%)"))) %>%
  mutate(pval = sprintf("%.3f",round(pval, 3)), 
         pval.treat.interact = sprintf("%.3f",round(pval.treat.interact,3))) 


p <- dat %>%
   mutate(name = factor(name, levels = c("age", 
                                        "height", 
                                        "weight", 
                                        "bmi", 
                                        "lean.rel", 
                                        "fat.rel"), 
                       labels = c("Age<br>(yrs)", 
                                  "Stature<br>(cm)", 
                                  "Body mass<br>(kg)", 
                                  "Body mass<br>index", 
                                  "Lean mass<br>(%)", 
                                  "Fat mass<br>(%)")), 
         sex = factor(sex, levels = c("m", "f"), 
                      labels = c("Male", "Female"))) %>%
  mutate(included = if_else(completed == "t4", "included", "excluded")) %>%
  

  

  
  
  
  summarise(.by = c(included, treat, name), 
            m = median(value), 
            q25 = quantile(value, 0.25), 
            q75 = quantile(value, 0.75), 
            min = min(value),
            max = max(value), 
            n = n()) %>%
  
      ## Fix names to include stats
  inner_join(stats) %>%
  mutate(name = if_else(name == "Age (yrs)", 
                        paste(name, 
                      "<br><span style = 'color:#0072B2; font-size:12px;'>Incl vs. Excl: p = ",
                      pval, 
                      "</span><br><span style = 'color:#D55E00; font-size:12px;'>Treat interact: p = ",

                      "</span>"),
                        paste(name, 
                      "<br><span style = 'color:#0072B2; font-size:12px;'>p = ",
                      pval, 
                      "</span><br><span style = 'color:#D55E00; font-size:12px;'>p = ",
                      pval.treat.interact,

  mutate(treat = if_else(treat == "omega", "N-3", "Placebo")) %>%

  ## Adding n()
  mutate(.by = grp,

  ggplot(aes(grp, m,
             group = grp,

  theme_classic() + 
  facet_wrap(~ name, scales = "free_x",

  coord_flip() +

        axis.title = element_blank(),

p
```

## Vastus lateralis thickness



```{r}
#| label: "fig-fig4"
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 3
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-cap: !expr 'glue::glue("Change in vastus lateralis thickness. Average difference in change scores between treatment groups was {inf_stats_vl}.")'


## Vastus lateralis data 
dat_fm <-   part %>% 
  filter(completed == "t4") %>%
  mutate(participant = as.character(participant)) %>%
  inner_join(AOData::bodycomp) %>%
  inner_join(AOData::idkeys %>%
               mutate(participant = as.character(participant))) %>%

  
  mutate(rel.fm = 100 * (fat.whole / (fat.whole + lean.whole + BMC.whole))) %>%
  
  select(participant, time, treat, sex, bmi, rel.fm) %>%
  inner_join(mutate(AOData::thickness, participant = as.character(participant))) %>%
  
  select(-VIthick) %>%
  
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = c(VLthick, rel.fm), 
              values_fn = mean)
  

## Models ###

# Effects of treatmenat on vastus lateralis thickness (hypertrophy)

dat_m <- dat_fm %>%
  
  mutate(change = VLthick_T4 - VLthick_T1) %>%
  
  select(participant, treat, sex, condition, change, rel.fm_T2, VLthick_T1) 



m1 <- lmerTest::lmer(change ~ VLthick_T1 + sex + treat + (1|participant),
                     data = dat_m)

inf_stats_vl <- paste0(round(coef(summary(m1))[4,1],1), 
       ", 95% CI: [",
       round(confint(m1)[6,1],1),
       ", ",
       round(confint(m1)[6,2],1),
       "], p = ", 
       round(coef(summary(m1))[4,5],3))



### Estimation plot ###############


est_plot <- function(model_plot = m1, 
                     dat_plot = dat_m, 
                     round = 3,
                     xaxis_just = 0,
                     yaxis = "Change") {
  
  # Calculate CI 
#  ci <- confint(model_plot) 
#  lwr <- ci["treatomega",][1]
# upr <- ci["treatomega",][2]
  
  # Group predictions
  grp_preds <- predictions(model_plot, by = c("treat"), re.form=NA) %>%
    data.frame()
  
  # Group comparisons
  grp_comp <- avg_comparisons(model_plot, variables = "treat", re.form=NA) %>%
    data.frame()
  
  lwr <- grp_comp[,"conf.low"]
  upr <- grp_comp[,"conf.high"]
  
  
  # Values for comp and second axis
  zero <- filter(grp_preds, treat == "ctrl") %>%
    pull(estimate)
  
  lwr <- zero + lwr 
  upr <- zero + upr
  
  # Range of ci
  range <- floor(upr - lwr)
  
  
  
  sec.scale <- signif(c(
    zero + range*3, 
    zero + range*2, 
    zero + range, 
    zero, 
    zero - range, 
    zero - range*2,
    zero - range*3))
  
  sec.scale.labels <- c(
    range*3,
    range*2,
    range,
    0, 
    -range,
    -range*2,
    -range*3)
  
  
  grp_preds<- grp_preds %>%
    mutate(conf.low = if_else(treat == "omega", lwr, zero), 
           conf.high = if_else(treat == "omega", upr, zero))
  # Create CI for comparison
  
 
  dat_plot %>%
    
    summarise(.by = c(treat, participant), 
              change = mean(change)) %>%
    
    ggplot(aes(treat, change, fill = treat)) + 
    
    # Add zero line 
    annotate("segment", y = zero, yend = zero, 
             x = 1.4, xend = 2.4, 
             lty = 2, color = "gray20") +
    
    
    # Add scale
    annotate("segment", y = min(sec.scale), yend = max(sec.scale), 
             x =2.4, xend = 2.4, 
             lty = 1, color = "gray20") +
    
    # ticks
    annotate("segment", y = sec.scale, yend = sec.scale, 
             x =2.4, xend = 2.42, 
             lty = 1, color = "gray20") +
    # Values for comp
    annotate("text", y = sec.scale, 
             x = 2.44,
             hjust = 0,
             size = 3.5,
             color = "gray30",
             label = sec.scale.labels) +
        annotate("text", y = zero, 
             x = 2.55 + xaxis_just,
             angle = -90,
             # hjust = 0,
             size = 6,
       
             color = "gray30",
             label = "Mean difference (95% CI)") +
    
    
    scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.1, 0.6), 
                   
                     labels = c("Placebo", "N-3")) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(colors[1], colors[4])) +
    
    geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2, 
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.05)) + 
    
    geom_errorbar(data = grp_preds, 
                  aes(treat, estimate, ymin = conf.low, 
                      ymax = conf.high),
               position = position_nudge(x = 0.2), 
               width = 0) +
    
    geom_point(data = grp_preds, 
               aes(treat, estimate, fill = treat),
               size = 4, 
               shape = 21,
               position = position_nudge(x = 0.2)) + 
    
    labs(y = yaxis) + 
    
    theme_classic(base_size = basesize) + 
    theme(legend.position = "none", 
          axis.title.x = element_blank())
    

  
}



p <- est_plot(model_plot = m1, 
         dat_plot = dat_m, 
         round = 3, 
         yaxis = "Pre- to post-\nintervention change (mm)")


p 




ggsave("pn-2024-figures/fig4.pdf", 
       p,
       width = 20, 
       device = cairo_pdf,
       height = 12, units = "cm")




```



## Lean mass

```{r}
#| label: "fig-fig5"
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 3
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-cap: !expr 'glue::glue("Change in whole body lean mass. Average difference in change scores between treatment groups was {inf_stats}.")'


### Lean mass ###
lean_dat <- part %>% 
  mutate(participant = as.character(participant)) %>%
  inner_join(AOData::bodycomp) %>%
  
  mutate(rel.fm = 100 * (fat.whole / (fat.whole + lean.whole + BMC.whole))) %>%

  
  select(participant, time, sex, rel.fm, lean.whole) %>%


  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T4")) %>%


  pivot_wider(names_from = time, 
               values_from = c(rel.fm, lean.whole)) %>%
 
  
  mutate(change = lean.whole_T4 - lean.whole_T1) %>%
  mutate(.by = sex, 
         scaled.t1 = (lean.whole_T1 - mean(lean.whole_T1)) / sd(lean.whole_T1)) %>%

  inner_join(AOData::idkeys %>%
               filter(completed == "t4") %>%
               mutate(participant = as.character(participant)))



m1 <- lm(change ~ scaled.t1 + sex + treat ,
                     data = lean_dat)


## Inferential stats

inf_stats <- paste0(round(coef(summary(m1))[4,1],1), 
       ", 95% CI: [",
       round(confint(m1)[4,1],1),
       ", ",
       round(confint(m1)[4,2],1),
       "], p = ", 
       round(coef(summary(m1))[4,4],3))





p <- est_plot(model_plot = m1, 
         dat_plot = lean_dat, 
         round = 3, 
         xaxis_just = 0.1,
         yaxis = "Pre- to post-\nintervention change (g)")


p 

ggsave("pn-2024-figures/fig5.pdf", 
       p,
       width = 20, 
       device = cairo_pdf,
       height = 12, units = "cm")


```

## Strength

```{r}
#| label: "fig-fig6"
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 3
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-cap: !expr 'glue::glue("Change average muscle strength (lower body). Average difference in change scores between treatment groups was {inf_stats_str}.")'


str_dat <- AOData::strength %>%
  
  inner_join(part) %>%
  
  select(participant:mag) %>%
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T4"), 
         condition != "RMNA", 
         mag > 5) %>%
 
  mutate(.by = exercise, 
         mag = 100 * (mag/max(mag))) %>%
  summarise(.by = c(participant, condition, time), 
            mag = mean(mag)) %>%
  

  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = mag) %>%
  mutate(change = T4 - T1, 
         participant = as.character(participant)) %>%
  
  inner_join(part %>% 
               mutate(participant = as.character(participant)) %>%
               inner_join(AOData::bodycomp) %>%
               
               mutate(rel.fm = 100 * (fat.whole / (fat.whole + lean.whole + BMC.whole))) %>%
              
               filter(time == "T1") %>%
               select(participant, rel.fm, sex)) %>%
    mutate(.by = sex, 
         scaled.t1 = (T1 - mean(T1)) / sd(T1))  %>%
  inner_join(AOData::idkeys %>%
               filter(completed == "t4") %>%
               mutate(participant = as.character(participant)))


m1 <- lmerTest::lmer(change ~ scaled.t1 + sex + treat + (1|participant),
                     data = str_dat)

inf_stats_str <- paste0(round(coef(summary(m1))[4,1],1), 
       ", 95% CI: [",
       round(confint(m1)[6,1],1),
       ", ",
       round(confint(m1)[6,2],1),
       "], p = ", 
       round(coef(summary(m1))[4,5],3))




p <- est_plot(model_plot = m1, 
         dat_plot = str_dat,
```

## Glucose metabolism

### Spline models of OGTT

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false


library(brms)
library(splines)


# Glucose
glucose_dat <- AOData::glucose %>%
  select(participant:glucose) 




part_t4 <- AOData::idkeys %>%
  filter(completed == "t4") %>%
  pull(participant)



compl_dat <- glucose_dat %>%
  # Keep data only from time 1 and 2
  filter(time %in% c("T1", "T4")) %>%
  # Filter participants who have completed T2
  filter(participant %in% part_t4) %>%
  # Remove NAs -- might update this to allow for not completly missing data 
  # to be imputed
  filter(!is.na(glucose)) %>%
  # Standardize glucose measurements
  mutate(stglucose = (glucose - mean(glucose)) /sd(glucose)) %>%
  ## Add treatment variable
  inner_join(AOData::idkeys %>%
  select(participant, treat)) %>%
  ## Combine data into a single variable (time/treat)
  mutate(tx = paste(time, treat, sep = "_")) 



```


```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

# get_prior(stglucose ~ 0 + tx + 
#             bs(min, df = 4):tx + 
#             (1 + bs(min, df = 4):time | participant), 
#                      data = compl_dat, 
#                      family = gaussian())
# 


p3 <- c(
  
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT1_ctrl"),  
                prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT1_omega"),  
                prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT4_ctrl"),  
                prior(normal(-1, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT4_omega"),  
               
               
               # Group/time priors for the splines
               prior(normal(1, 1.5),    class = b, coef = "txT1_ctrl:bsmindfEQ41"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT1_ctrl:bsmindfEQ42"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5),   class = b, coef = "txT1_ctrl:bsmindfEQ43"),
               prior(normal(-0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT1_ctrl:bsmindfEQ44"),
               
                 prior(normal(1, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT1_omega:bsmindfEQ41"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT1_omega:bsmindfEQ42"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5),   class = b, coef = "txT1_omega:bsmindfEQ43"),
               prior(normal(-0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT1_omega:bsmindfEQ44"),
               
                 prior(normal(1, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT4_ctrl:bsmindfEQ41"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT4_ctrl:bsmindfEQ42"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5),   class = b, coef = "txT4_ctrl:bsmindfEQ43"),
               prior(normal(-0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT4_ctrl:bsmindfEQ44"),
               
                 prior(normal(1, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT4_omega:bsmindfEQ41"),
               prior(normal(0.5, 1.5),  class = b, coef = "txT4_omega:bsmindfEQ42"),
               prior(normal(-1, 1.5),   class = b, coef = "txT4_omega:bsmindfEQ43"),
               prior(normal(-0.5, 1.5), class = b, coef = "txT4_omega:bsmindfEQ44"),
               # 
               prior(lkj(1), class = cor),
               # The wigglyness SD sampled from exponential distribution
               prior(exponential(2), class = sd),
               prior(exponential(1), class = sigma))
               
               
               
# 
# validate_prior(p3,
#                stglucose ~ 0 + tx + 
#             bs(min, df = 4):tx + 
#             (1 + bs(min, df = 4):time | participant), 
#                      data = compl_dat, 
#                      family = gaussian())


m3_pp <- brm(stglucose ~ 0 + tx + 
            bs(min, df = 4):tx + 
            (1 + bs(min, df = 4):time | participant),
             # Priors
             prior = p3,
             file = "fits/pn-2024/ogtt-analysis/m3_pp", # Save the model
             sample_prior = "only", # Sample only from the prior
             data = compl_dat, 
             family = gaussian(),
             chains = 4, 
             iter = 2000, 
             warmup = 1000, 
             control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95))

## New data 

nd <- expand_grid(min = seq(0, 120, 10), 
                  participant = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
                  time = c("T1", "T4")) %>%
  mutate(treat = if_else(participant %in% c(1, 2), "ctrl", "omega"), 
         tx = paste(time, treat, sep = "_")) 



preds_prior <- predictions(m3_pp, newdata = nd, 
                           allow_new_levels = TRUE)


# posterior_draws(preds_prior) %>%
#   filter(drawid %in% 1:500) %>%
#   ggplot(aes(min, draw,
#              color = tx,
#              group = paste(participant, drawid))) + 
#   geom_line(alpha = 0.1) + 
#   
#   facet_grid(time ~ participant) +
#   
#   labs(title = "Prior predictive simulation",
#        x = "Sample time",
#        y = "Glucose (standardized)") 



```



```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false


m3 <- update(m3_pp, 
             newdata = compl_dat, 
             sample_prior = "no", # Sample from the posterior
             file = "fits/pn-2024/ogtt-analysis/m3", 
             iter = 4000, 
             warmup = 1000, 
             cores = 4,
             control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95))


```



```{r}
#| label: "fig-fig10"
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 3
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-cap: !expr 'glue::glue("")'





# Predictions

nd <- expand_grid(min = seq(0, 120, 5), 
                  time = c("T1", "T4"), 
                  treat = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                  participant = NA) %>%
  mutate(tx = paste(time, treat, sep = "_")) 



preds <- predictions(m3, newdata = nd, re_formula = NA) 

# Retrieve mean and average to plot on the original scale

m <- mean(compl_dat$glucose)
s <- sd(compl_dat$glucose)


comp_df <- posterior_draws(preds) %>%
  filter(drawid %in% 1:2000) %>%
    # Add mean and multiply by sd
  mutate(draw = (draw * s) + m) %>%
  select(drawid, min, draw, tx, participant) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = tx, values_from = draw) %>%
  
  # Compare "groups" as within group differences between time points
  # Compare differences over time between groups (tx_contrast)
  mutate(ctrl = T4_ctrl - T1_ctrl, 
         omega = T4_omega - T1_omega, 
         tx_contrast = omega - ctrl) %>%
  
  pivot_longer(cols = T1_ctrl:tx_contrast) 


  
# Using the data we can calculate 95% credible intervals for the differences between groups.
  
m3_comp <- comp_df %>%  

  # Group the data frame by sample time
  group_by(min, name) %>%
  # ... and calculate summary statistics for the differences
  summarise(m = median(value, na.rm = TRUE), 
            l95 = quantile(value, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE), 
            u95 = quantile(value, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE), 
            l50 = quantile(value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 
            u50 = quantile(value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)) 

  
p <- m3_comp %>%
  
  filter(name %in% c("T1_ctrl", "T1_omega", "T4_ctrl", "T4_omega")) %>%
  
  separate(name, into = c("time", "treat")) %>%
  
  mutate(treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3")), 
         time = factor(time, levels = c("T1", "T4"), 
                       labels = c("Pre-intervention", "Post-intervention"))) %>%

  ggplot(aes(min, m, fill = time)) + 
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l95, ymax = u95), alpha = 0.6) +
   geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = l50, ymax = u50), alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line() + 
  labs(x = "Sample time (min)", y = "Blood glucose (mmol L<sup>-1</sup>)") + 
  facet_wrap(~ treat) + 
  
    scale_color_manual(values = c(colors[2], colors[3])) +
   scale_fill_manual(values = c(colors[2], colors[3])) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = basesize) +
  
  theme(axis.title.y = element_markdown(), 
        legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.background = element_rect(color = "white"), 
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0), 
        legend.title = element_blank())



p


ggsave("pn-2024-figures/fig10.pdf", 
       p,
       width = 20, 
       device = cairo_pdf,
       height = 12, units = "cm")
```

## Effects of baseline fat mass on treatment effect on muscle hypertrophy (Vastus lateralis thickness)



```{r}
#| label: "fig-fig13"
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-cap: !expr 'glue::glue("Model predictions from the interaction between baseline fat mass and treatment on muscle thickness. The model controls for baseline muscle thickness and sex. {fat_mass_inf}")'

 

 
 
 dat_fm <-   part %>% 
   filter(completed == "t4") %>%
   mutate(participant = as.character(participant)) %>%
   inner_join(AOData::bodycomp) %>%
   inner_join(AOData::idkeys %>%
                mutate(participant = as.character(participant))) %>%

   
   mutate(rel.fm = 100 * (fat.whole / (fat.whole + lean.whole +  BMC.whole))) %>%
   
   select(participant, time, treat, sex, bmi, rel.fm) %>%
   inner_join(mutate(AOData::thickness, 
                     participant =  as.character(participant))) %>%
   
   select(-VIthick) %>%
   
   pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = c(VLthick, rel.fm), 
               values_fn = mean) %>%
   mutate(scaled.t1 = (VLthick_T1 - mean(VLthick_T1)) /  sd(VLthick_T1), 
          .by = sex)
 
 
 
 m <- lmerTest::lmer(VLthick_T4 ~ scaled.t1 + sex + treat * rel.fm_T1  + (1|participant), 
                     data = dat_fm)
 

 
 relfm <- c(mean(dat_fm$rel.fm_T1) - sd(dat_fm$rel.fm_T1) * 2, 
            mean(dat_fm$rel.fm_T1), 
            mean(dat_fm$rel.fm_T1) + sd(dat_fm$rel.fm_T1) * 2)
 
 
p <- predictions(m, newdata = expand_grid(treat = c("omega", "ctrl"), 
                                         sex = c("m", "f"), 
                                         scaled.t1 = 0, 
                                         rel.fm_T1 = relfm, 
                                         participant = NA), 
                re.form = NA) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  
  mutate(rel.fm_T1 = if_else(rel.fm_T1 == relfm[1], 
                             "Mean relative fat mass - 2 &times; SD",
                             if_else(rel.fm_T1 == relfm[2],
                            "Mean relative fat mass",                                            if_else(rel.fm_T1 == relfm[3], "Mean relative fat mass + 2 &times; SD", "OTHER"))), 
         rel.fm_T1 = factor(rel.fm_T1, levels = c("Mean relative fat mass + 2 &times; SD", "Mean relative fat mass", "Mean relative fat mass - 2 &times; SD")),
         sex = if_else(sex == "m", "Male", "Female"), 
         treat = factor(treat, levels = c("ctrl", "omega"), 
                        labels = c("Placebo", "N-3"))) %>%
 
  
  ggplot(aes(treat, estimate, color = rel.fm_T1,
             fill = rel.fm_T1,
             group = rel.fm_T1)) + 
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3) + 
  geom_line(size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ sex) + 
  theme_classic(base_size = basesize) + 
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c(colors[1:3])) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(colors[1:3])) +
  
  labs(y = "Estimated post-intervention<br>VL thickness (mm)") +
  
    theme(axis.title.y = element_markdown(),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_markdown(),
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        strip.background = element_rect(color = "white"), 
        strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0), 
        legend.title = element_blank()) 
  
 
p

 ggsave("pn-2024-figures/fig13.pdf", 
       p,
       width = 16, 
       device = cairo_pdf,
       height = 12, units = "cm")

 
 ## Stats
 
 
 
fat_mass_inf <- paste0("Relative fat mass at baseline tended to be negatively associated with 
        muscle hypertrophy (p = ",
        round(coef(summary(m))[5,5],3), 
        "). This effect was not reversed in the N-3 treatment (p = ",
        round(coef(summary(m))[6,5],3),
        ").")
```
